I'm pretty sure that the first and third were Lon Moore's images, and he (although gone from Holotown) may be concerned that no credit line was included with your post. I would. 

Making copies at home of published images is certainly "fair use", but posting the results to a public web site, without a credit line, as "what I am able to produce" isn't.

Great copies though!
